tour.welcomeBody: Explore Türkiye's plant diversity on the map. Here's a quick tour of the interface — feel free to hit "Skip" at any time.
tour.modesBody: Switch between Davis squares (the academic standard grid), individual occurrence points, or a density heatmap.
tour.searchBody: Search by Latin or Turkish name, or narrow the map by picking a class, family, or genus from the tree on the left.
tour.treeBody: Clicking a species in the tree opens detailed information, images, and its location on the map on the right.
tour.contributeBodyAnon: If you'd like to record a plant you've seen in the field, you can create a free account here.
tour.contributeBodyPending: Your account was created — once an admin approves it, you'll be able to add observations here.
tour.contributeBodyApproved: Record a plant you've seen in the field, with its location and a photo, right here.
